Pi_0.formula: rho(K_infinity) = max eigenvalue of spatial reproduction operator
Pi_0.interpretation: Basic spatial reproduction number across generational lifecycle

Pi_M.interpretation: Mobilization strain index: recruitment & fielding burn rate vs capital
Pi_M.universality_status: Falsified as single universal scalar (within-strain dispersion > 15%); derived as two-timescale ratio Pi_M = tau_replenish / tau_mobilize

Pi_S.interpretation: Ratio of state institutional regeneration tempo to conflict tempo
Pi_S.empirical_finding: Q_S(180) ~ 0.007; state capacity is strongly hysteretic and does not passively recover from central fiscal injection over 180 days

phase_regimes.name: Endogenous Extinction
phase_regimes.physical_mechanism: Subcritical reproduction without external sanctuary or material subsidy. Each generation produces fewer than 1 spatial offspring, leading to demographic and organizational extinction within finite time.
phase_regimes.typical_outcome: Insurgent organization collapses, footholds extinguish, 0 active formations.

phase_regimes.name: Mobilization Trap (Resource Exhaustion)
phase_regimes.physical_mechanism: Mobilization rate and fighter conversion outrun organizational material replenishment. Fielded force creates unsustainable burn rate, exhausting central organizational capital to 0. Produces catastrophic organizational collapse despite high initial recruitment mass.
phase_regimes.typical_outcome: Hard capital exhaustion, organizational disbanding, stranded formations.

phase_regimes.name: Externally Maintained Persistence
phase_regimes.physical_mechanism: Endogenous reproduction is subcritical, but cross-border external sanctuary or foreign resource transfers replenish losses faster than local attrition.
phase_regimes.typical_outcome: Border-adjacent persistence, immune to local COIN clearing.

phase_regimes.name: Localized Endemic Persistence
phase_regimes.physical_mechanism: Balanced generation dynamics. Insurgent replaces losses locally at a sustainable rate without overtaxing capital stocks or expanding beyond local rough terrain.
phase_regimes.typical_outcome: Protracted low-intensity conflict, stable foothold presence.

phase_regimes.name: Spatial Expansion
phase_regimes.physical_mechanism: Supercritical spatial reproduction. Parent rooted membership establishes offspring in adjacent network localities via recruitment waves within generation horizon tau_g <= 158 days.
phase_regimes.typical_outcome: Multi-district expansion, governance erosion, foothold network growth.

phase_regimes.name: State Consolidation (Durable Quiet)
phase_regimes.physical_mechanism: State authority maintains overwhelming competitive margin. Insurgent organizational capital and membership depth are suppressed below establishment threshold.
phase_regimes.typical_outcome: Full government administrative and physical control.

bifurcation_boundaries.extinction_boundary: Pi_0 = 1.0 (transcritical bifurcation between extinction and endemic survival)
bifurcation_boundaries.mobilization_trap_boundary: Pi_M in [0.25, 0.25] (saddle-node bifurcation causing sudden capital collapse)

theoretical_compression_summary: The multi-agent dynamics of Pineland compress into a universal phase diagram governed by four dimensionless groups: Pi_0 (reproduction), Pi_M (mobilization strain), Pi_S (state renewal), and Gamma (competitive margin). The boundaries demarcate distinct qualitative dynamical regimes with zero reference to historical data fitting.
